Bettina, I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup." It's in your mailbox and unsent.

It uses the bullets from Sofia's note in this channel and adds your two lines: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. I didn't open Sofia's saved draft, so if she changed it there, that version won't carry over.
